verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single first-party line saying users can forward physical items wherever they need them. That covers generic forwarding of mail items, and the real street addresses suggest it may be able to receive deliveries. Nothing in the pack mentions packages specifically, carrier acceptance, consolidation or holding for pickup. Missing for 10: explicit package acceptance from all major carriers (UPS/FedEx/DHL/USPS), package consolidation, hold-for-pickup option, package forwarding details and costs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
